description.value: Sports Rent, now also trading as Coastal Ski & Sport, is a multi-sport rental and retail shop on Government Street in Victoria offering one of the broadest cycling rental fleets in the city. Tourists and touring cyclists can choose from city hybrids, road and gravel bikes, mountain bikes, and electric bikes, with pannier bags, child trailers, and clipless pedals available as add-on rentals. Every bike rental comes bundled with a helmet, lock, repair kit, and map.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 46m; rack (8 spaces) at 65m; rack (12 spaces) at 73m. Total: 28 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sportsrentbc.com is live and confirmed as the same business — the copyright footer reads '© 2026 SPORTS RENT' — though it now operates under the brand 'Coastal Ski & Sport'. The bike rentals subpage explicitly lists six bike categories including electric bikes, with touring accessories such as pannier bags, and states all rentals include a helmet, lock, repair kit, and map. The only services page fetched (/winter-shop-services/) covers ski/snowboard tuning and boot fitting only, so bike mechanical service capabilities cannot be confirmed from the available website content.
concerns: Business has rebranded to 'Coastal Ski & Sport' — website navigation and page titles consistently use the new name, while the copyright footer retains 'SPORTS RENT'. OSM name likely needs updating to reflect current trading name.
The specific OSM URL (https://sportsrentbc.com/index.html) returns a 404 due to a site redesign; the root domain sportsrentbc.com is live and functional.
OSM opening hours (Mo-Th 09:00-17:30; Fr 09:00-18:00; Sa,Su 10:00-17:00) differ from the website, which lists Tuesday and Wednesday as closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bike rental and multi-sport shop in Victoria with a comprehensive cycling fleet including e-bikes and touring-relevant accessories — directly useful to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact email from website: coastalskisportsrent@gmail.com. Pannier bag rentals are a notable offering for touring cyclists doing multi-day routes.

Bike rentals.detail: Six bike categories available: City Hybrid, Sport Hybrid, Mountain, Road + Gravel, Youth, and Electric Bikes; accessories include pannier bags, child trailer, trail-a-bike, child seat, and clipless pedals; all rentals include helmet, lock, repair kit, and map
